/**
 * Shorthand for {@code Streams.failableStream(value == null ? Stream.empty() : Stream.of(value))}.
 *
 * @param <T> the type of stream elements.
 * @param value the single element of the new stream, may be {@code null}.
 * @return the new FailableStream on {@code value} or an empty stream.
 * @since 3.15.0
 */
public static <T> FailableStream<T> failableStream(final T value) {
    return failableStream(createStreamFromValue(value));
}

/**
 * Creates a stream from a single value, returning empty stream if value is null.
 *
 * @param <T> the type of stream elements.
 * @param value the value to create stream from, may be {@code null}.
 * @return Stream containing the value or empty stream if value is null.
 */
private static <T> Stream<T> createStreamFromValue(final T value) {
    return value == null ? Stream.empty() : Stream.of(value);
}
